caption:
Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) is the single most practical finance check you can run before committing to a commercial mortgage. Start by normalizing 12 months of income, subtract recurring operating expenses and realistic reserves to find NOI, then annualize principal-plus-interest to determine annual debt service. Divide NOI by debt service to see whether the property’s cash flow comfortably covers payments. Always stress-test with conservative vacancy and expense scenarios, and watch for red flags like overstated rents, omitted capex, or missing reserves. Locally, build in property tax, insurance, and older-building maintenance trends for Chester and Montgomery County deals. If DSCR looks tight, consider higher reserves, operational fixes, or revisiting loan structure before closing. Gather your 12-month income and loan amortization schedule and visit dmsellscre.com/investors for calculators, templates, and a quick deal review. DM questions or bring a deal and I’ll show how to run the numbers.
